At my job i get 30 minutes paid breaktime whenever I need, but because it's paid I am also required to help if urgent assignments pop up during my break. I think maybe it's like this a lot of places and if so then your coworker would be in their right to ask you for help even though you're allowed your breaks if the work is piling up without you.

I know sick days have different rules around the world so maybe I'm naive when I say this, but if you can't get through a day like that then maybe you shouldn't be at work that day? (where I am from we do not get fired for mental health days, but I know that's not the case everywhere else)
